title: The Experiment That Waited 69 Years For One Drop
hook: One Pitch Drop Took 69 Years To Fall
closing: Some discoveries matter because someone was patient enough to keep watching.
question: Could you wait that long?

segments.say: The experiment produced just 9 pitch drops, turning waiting itself into the result.
Dublin's experiment waited 69 years for a drop, proving similar materials can move on wildly different clocks.
Pitch is 230 billion times more viscous than water, explaining why a liquid can look completely solid.
